summary: First iteration full test of Divine Journey (Sanathana Dharma) app. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass on /api/, /api/panchangam (today/date/invalid/week), /api/bookmarks CRUD, /api/rituals/done POST/GET/DELETE with idempotency check. Frontend: verified persistent audio player on all pages, language switcher (English -> Telugu -> back), chant switcher changes track title from 'Om Chanting (108 times)' to 'Gāyatrī Mantra', /deities grid renders 12 tiles, /deities/ganesha shows Mūla Mantra + Dhyāna Ślokam + Stotras + Ashtottara, /dinacharya renders 10 ritual timeline items with expand toggle and ritual-done button (persists via API), /panchangam shows week strip with 7 day buttons and updates on click, /festivals shows 11 items with Story/Celebrate/Pooja Vidhi/Mantras sections in detail panel.
critical_code_review_comments: Panchangam calculation uses a demo/approximate formula (linear index off epoch) — clearly documented as simplified; acceptable for MVP but not astronomically accurate. Consider integrating a proper ephemeris (pyswisseph/drik) if production accuracy is needed.
Sunrise/sunset are static approximations, not location-aware — no lat/long input.
Bookmarks and ritual_log collections have no compound index on (device_id, date_str/ref_id); low volume expected so acceptable, but add indexes if the app scales.
External audio URLs on archive.org return intermittent 503 in console — non-blocking since task said not to wait for real audio, but consider hosting fallback URLs.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_ prefixed device_id bookmarks / ritual_log entries created and cleaned up within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_divine_journey.py covers all 7 API endpoints. All frontend data-testids used per spec (persistent-audio-player, lang-switcher, lang-option-te, chant-switcher, chant-option-gayatri, deity-tile-<id>, ritual-toggle-<id>, ritual-done-<id>, day-YYYY-MM-DD, festival-item-*, festival-detail) are present and functional. Only external audio 503s in console — expected.
